title: AI On Your Phone. No Internet.

slides.text: Qwen 3.5 lets you run a <accent>real AI model</accent> on your phone. No internet. No subscription. No data leaving your device. <accent>Download once, use forever.</accent>

slides.heading: What Is <accent>Qwen 3.5?</accent>
slides.body:
- Alibaba's Small Model Series, built for on-device use
- 4 sizes: 0.8B (ultra light), 2B (fast), 4B (sweet spot), 9B (near cloud quality)
- Open source (Apache 2.0), free on Hugging Face

slides.heading: Not Just <accent>Text</accent> Chat
items: Text Generation: Full conversations and content creation
Vision AI: Analyze images directly on device
Voice Transcription: Whisper-powered speech to text
Document Analysis: Read and understand PDFs and docs

slides.heading: How To <accent>Run</accent> It
before: Tip: Set KV cache to q4_0

slides.heading: Real <accent>Use Cases</accent>
slides.body:
- Developer debugging code on a flight with no Wi-Fi
- Student in a rural area learning from an AI tutor offline
- Field worker getting instant answers without cell coverage
- Privacy-first user who never wants data leaving their device
- Apps that work without internet dependency

slides.heading: Setup: <accent>iPhone</accent>
slides.body:
- App Store: 'Off Grid' or 'PocketPal AI'
- Both free, no account needed
- Tap model browser
- Models filtered by your device RAM
- Start with Qwen 3 0.6B or 1.5B

slides.heading: Setup: <accent>Android</accent>
slides.body:
- Open Play Store, search 'Off Grid'
- Install (free, open source, MIT)
- Browse recommended models
- Pick based on your RAM (6GB+)
- Turn on airplane mode to verify

slides.heading: Pro Tip: <accent>Speed Boost</accent>
slides.body:
- After your first chat, go to Settings
- Find 'KV Cache Quantization'
- Switch from f16 to q4_0
- This roughly triples inference speed with minimal quality loss
- First message is always slower (model loads into memory)
- Subsequent messages are much faster

slides.text: AI that works without the internet is not a feature. It's the future.
